title: In South Korea, 'Swedish massage' can mean more than a massage
caption:
In South Korea, the term 'Swedish massage' has been co-opted as a front for illegal activity. Authorities are struggling to regulate a massive, underground industry using these misleading labels.

Source: Koreaherald - In South Korea, 'Swedish massage' can mean more than a massage
